notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Helloooo everyone  👋 

Factory Outlet Simulator launches in early access on July 15th! 🎉 

Features that will be added to our game during this period:

-Surprise new products (it will be a real surprise!)
-Stock exchange app (you will have a lot of fun!)
-Theft and security camera (protecting your factory is a must...)
-Employees (they will make your job much easier...)
-Airport for wholesale (transportation to the whole world is now faster!)
-Trucks (we know you need a bigger truck..)
-Bank app (level design will become very difficult, and you will want to take out a loan...)
-Forklift - Machine repair - Credit cards - Invoice (essential when running a factory!)

And we are very excited to meet you with many more planned innovations! 🚀 
Let us know what features you want us to add and any feedback! 🙌

notes.title: Tomorrow is Prologue Release Day!⏰
notes.notes:
Hello everyone👋 

Tomorrow our prologue version will be available!
We have prepared a few extra surprises for our prologue version. 🚀 

You will be able to produce phone cases and mugs in your factory. You will also be able to upload your own images to your designs! 🎉

You can share other items you want to produce with us on our community channels.🙏 

We are very excited to meet you. See you tomorrow!⏰

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Greetings to everyone,

First of all, thank you very much for your interest and support!
On May 24th, we are very excited to meet you, our valuable players, with our prologue version (free)!
We can't wait to hear your feedback!

We will develop our game together!
